text:
leo: Heads-up — noticed a spike in missing counts for `session_count` agg in eu-west for Jan 14-16. dashboard shows zeros but raw ingest has events.

maria: ugh, saw that alert too. Looks like the streaming dedupe worker had a brief outage. Do we have a list of affected partitions?

aj: I ran a quick scan, looks like partitions with ingest_ts between 2026-01-14T00:00 and 2026-01-16T12:00, sharded by customer_id % 32 -> shards 6,7,8 are undercounted. SQL I used:```sql
select shard, count(*) as raw_events, sum(agg_present::int) as present_agg
from telemetry_events
where ingestion_date between '2026-01-14' and '2026-01-16'
group by shard;
```

ben: thanks. From SRE side, need to be careful with backfill load — last time a big recompute spiked router CPU because of concurrent parquet reads. Can we run in priority lanes?

sre_tina: I'm oncall for the night shift. I can own the rollback hook and watch Prom dashboards. Suggest we run a staged recompute: sample -> small shard window -> full. Also set an abort if error rate > 10% or avg latency > 2s for API reads.

maria: plan sounds good. We should also respect quota gating so this backfill doesn't evict normal traffic. Proposal: use fair-share queue with 20% reserved capacity, concurrency cap 6, and run 02:00-05:00 UTC.

leo: +1. Can we do a dry-run on two shards (6 and 7) first and surface diffs to the ops-dashboard?

aj: yes. Dry-run command (internal tool):```bash
recompute --shards 6,7 --window 2026-01-14T00:00/2026-01-16T12:00 --dry-run --emit-diff /tmp/diff-2198765432.json
```

ben: add an indexer throttle flag so we don't overwhelm objectstore: `--max-parallel-writes=4` and `--s3-put-qps=40`.

ops-bot: scheduled job request received: job_request_id=jr-2198765432, owner=leo, mode=dry-run, shards=[6,7], window=[2026-01-14T00:00,2026-01-16T12:00]. ETA 02:05 UTC.

deploy-bot: dry-run job started: job_id=backfill-dry-2198765432-01. logs: https://internal-logs/redwood/backfills/backfill-dry-2198765432-01

leo: I'll watch diffs and post to the ops-dashboard channel. If diff rate under 0.5% then proceed to rolling recompute for remaining shards.

maria: quick UX ask for Console: can we add a "backfill impact" preview that estimates token/IO cost and expected runtime? would help PMs sign off faster.

aj: noted — I can stub an estimator: uses row count * avg-serialization-size / throughput-per-worker. rough command:```py
estimate(rows, size_bytes, workers):
    return (rows * size_bytes) / (workers * throughput_bytes_per_sec)
```

ben: also log routing policy used for these requests (fair-share) so ops can attribute latency. add tags: `backfill=true`, `priority=fair-share`, `quota_group=backfill-night`.

sre_tina: dry-run looks clean so far. diff rate 0.12% on shard 6, 0.09% shard 7. Ready to promote to full with same throttles. I will be on call and keep runbooks open. @maria can you trigger?

maria: triggering full recompute now with caps: --concurrency=6 --max-parallel-writes=4 --s3-put-qps=40 --abort-if-error-rate=0.10 --priority=fair-share.

ops-bot: scheduled job request received: job_request_id=jr-2198765432-full, owner=maria, mode=run, shards=all_affected, window=[2026-01-14T00:00,2026-01-16T12:00], start_window=2026-01-15T02:00Z, end_window=2026-01-15T05:00Z.

deploy-bot: backfill started: job_id=backfill-2198765432-run-01, tracker: https://internal-jobs/ui/backfill-2198765432-run-01

leo: logging note for postmortem: add cause=dedupe-worker-outage, mitigation=priority-backfill+quota, owners=[maria,aj,sre_tina].

ben: SRE request: include a gradual ramp-up (10% -> 50% -> 100%) over 30m to avoid thundering herd on parquet reads.

maria: implemented ramp-up via `--ramp 0.1/0.5/1.0 --ramp-steps 3 --ramp-duration 30m`.

aj: will capture metrics to a temporary Prom namespace `backfill/2198765432` and push diffs to S3 at s3://redwood-backfill-diffs/2198765432/diffs.json

sre_tina: monitoring checklists: CPU, router-5xx, objectstore-5xx, avg-parse-latency, backfill-delta-rate. I set alerts to page at thresholds.

leo: thanks team. Post-run, let's add a small Console widget showing "recent recomputes" with outcomes (diff-rate, duration, cost-estimate). This will help PMs and support triage.

maria: filing short follow-up ticket: ENG-ops: console backfill preview + recent recomputes widget.

ben: I'll keep the thread open during window and post any incidents here. :thumbsup:

leo: good run. will do final summary after job completes and upload runbook notes.
